title: Spanish Gold Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Allied Brass
description: Add organized storage to your bath or shower with this 18.75-inch wall-mounted shower basket. Available in Spanish Gold. Spanish Gold presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired. The oval combination caddy provides a secure place for shampoo, conditioner, soap, and daily essentials while the ventilated, heavy-gauge solid brass wires promote drainage and will never rust. Solid brass construction delivers lasting durability, and the concealed screw mounting system creates a clean, finished appearance on the wall. Overall size is 18.75 in L x 2.25 in H x 4.13 in W with 4.13 in projection. Includes the basket and all installation hardware; no assembly required. A smart upgrade for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures, and it’s backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
